gsc.period_label: Selected 3 months; available chart data 2026-08-11 to 2026-08-31

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Micocat and species competitors rank for Catalan↔Spanish names; 'setas en catalan' 390 searches/mo, KD 9.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: A canonical Catalan–Spanish–scientific glossary linked from every species profile.
content_gaps.risk_note: Do not create duplicate translated species pages unless a full hreflang strategy is funded.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Bolets.com has a deep 'Buscant bolets' archive covering routes, tools, navigation and technique.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: A beginner hub: preparation, basket/knife, sustainable picking, navigation, weather, safety and legal links.
content_gaps.risk_note: Generalize locations; never reveal sensitive ecological spots.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Bolets.com exposes 30+ dedicated recipe articles; competitors rank for camagroc, rovelló and stew queries.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: One recipe hub plus carefully selected species subpages: rovellons, camagrocs, ceps, fredolics.
content_gaps.risk_note: Keep food safety and correct identification warnings prominent.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Competitors have dedicated freezing, drying and rovelló-preserve pages; current site has one generic guide.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: Expand the existing guide with indexable sections or child pages for ceps, camagrocs and rovellons.
content_gaps.risk_note: Avoid thin pages; consolidate when search demand is small.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Low-KD demand exists for toxic fredolics, poisonous níscalos and false lookalikes.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: Comparison hubs plus a sourced emergency-response page with Poison Control/112 guidance.
content_gaps.risk_note: High-stakes content needs authoritative sources and explicit limits; never imply edibility certification.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Competitors publish extensive pine, oak and forest explainers tied to mushrooms.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: A 'bolets i arbres' hub mapping tree/forest types to likely species and ecological caveats.
content_gaps.risk_note: Present habitat compatibility, not collection coordinates or guaranteed presence.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Bolets.com's rain-data page dominates generic Meteocat/radar demand; its page explains current versus historical rain.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: A user-facing explainer tying rain history, temperature and soil moisture to the existing model and map.
content_gaps.risk_note: Do not chase generic 'Meteocat radar' head terms as a standalone weather portal.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: La Casa de las Setas covers spores, mycelium, lifecycle and mycorrhizae in depth.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: Extend anatomy into lifecycle, spores, mycelium and mycorrhizae, with links to method/species pages.
content_gaps.risk_note: Educational authority play; lower immediate product intent.

content_gaps.competitor_evidence: Competitors rank for mycelium and cultivation-related terms.
content_gaps.recommended_asset: Only pursue if the editorial scope expands beyond wild mushroom hunting.
content_gaps.risk_note: Weak fit with the current prediction/field-use product; defer behind core clusters.
